text_block_list.text:
Midsummer. The season for summer training 
camp has arrived!

At the training camp beneath the blazing, 
intense sunlight. On that beach—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Forward, my Opera O Troupe!!!!!

T.M. Opera O's resonant command echoed far 
and wide.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I am alone no longer. For I 
now possess mighty subordinates of my 
generation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, and Doto! They shall serve as 
our vanguard and lead the charge!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this training camp is, so to speak, 
—the trial battle for the generational 
clash!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look, behold over there—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
S-Spe-chan, stop that... Please don't 
splash water on me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I won't stop, Grass-chan. Please 
stay still♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder, Special Week... Heroes of 
the previous generation are also taking 
part in this training camp.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The opposition is formidable, to be 
sure—warriors worth a thousand each. Yet 
we will not be outdone!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Ayabe-san, Doto! Using the opera 
troupe's prop 'washtub from above,' I 
shall drench the two of you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm, Ayabe-san? Doto? Where are you!?

There's no one else in sight. Which 
means...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What?! You mean to tell me she's still 
holed up in the training camp lodge?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Doto did say she 
wasn't confident in wearing a swimsuit...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san has been brilliantly leaving me 
on read over and over. I was convinced it 
was her way of expressing, "I'll be right 
there!", though.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we are clearly lacking in 
fighting strength. Our disadvantage is 
undeniable. However...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is still hope! Because the elite of 
the elite are standing by my side!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now advance, march forward, my Trainer! 
You are the only piece left upon my board!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall join those two and relentlessly 
splash them with seawater while going, 'Oh 
my~, you silly girl, Grass-chan~♪'!
(*tap-tap-tap-tap...!*)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun!? Hey, where are you 
going!?

I flee from the scene at full speed. 
Spending a summer keeping T.M. Opera O 
company alone seems like it would take an 
absurd amount of effort.
